waypoints.name: High Bridge (Stehekin Valley Road)
waypoints.directions: No road reaches Stehekin. Take the passenger ferry up Lake Chelan from Chelan or Fields Point Landing to Stehekin, then ride the shuttle bus up the Stehekin Valley Road to High Bridge, where the Pacific Crest Trail crosses the Stehekin River.

waypoints.name: Needle Peak summit (first summit of the traverse)
waypoints.directions: Follow the Pacific Crest Trail south up Agnes Creek about 8.5 to 9 miles to Swamp Creek Camp. Take the unmaintained Swamp Creek path and leave it near 3,200 ft, climbing steep, brushy slopes onto Needle Peak's long north ridge. Follow the ridge, turning cliff bands near 7,300 ft on the west, to the summit ridge and the broad summit.
